complete_examples.text: However, most of the embankments of the high-speed railways that have been constructed in China are in seasonal or permafrost areas, the embankments suffer from long-term freeze-thaw cycles with the change of season and environmental temperature.
The temperature field of permafrost is accompanied by freeze-thaw cycles of moisture during the long-term evolution, thus, the phase transformation of moisture in the soil must be considered.
